planets.name: TOI-1478 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-1478 with a 10.2-day year, found in 2021.

text.card: TOI-1478 b was found in 2021 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-1478. Its orbit and size follow Rice et al. 2022's fit, the archive's default.
